tldr: Alibaba opened a preview of its next model, Qwen4-Max, but published no weights, no scores and no price sheet. A seven-month count of Anthropic's bug-hunting project found 442 security flaws, 2 of them exploited in the wild, and only 217 fixes. OpenAI bought a small travel agent startup and hired its founder, then shut the product down. OpenAI will show security tools built from bugs its own models caught, in a keynote on 12 November. Two research posts ask why thinking longer sometimes helps an answer and sometimes makes it worse.

articles.title: Qwen4-Max opens in preview on Alibaba's Token Plan
articles.summary: Qwen4-Max previews on Alibaba's Token Plan with no weights, benchmarks or context length published; the plan bans scheduled automation.

articles.title: Glasswing audit: 442 CVEs in seven months, 217 fixed
articles.summary: VulnCheck counts 37,966 Glasswing findings, 7,349 public and 217 fixed, and says 2 of 442 CVEs were exploited in the wild.

articles.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, a year-old AI travel agent
articles.summary: Sonder founder Francis Davidson joins OpenAI; the travel product is already shut down and no travel product was announced.

articles.title: OpenAI to show security tools built from its own bug hunting
articles.summary: A 12 November keynote promises tools and playbooks from flaws OpenAI's own models found and fixed in its code and infrastructure.

articles.title: Flide speeds decision-time inference with exact state forking
articles.summary: The paper lets parallel search branches share one exact prefix, cutting the cost of running many candidate paths.

articles.title: What objective is reasoning solving?
articles.summary: Treats chains of thought as pathfinding in token space: training raises the odds of a good path, not that one path converges.
